spans.s:
ली {vI.v} {c1c} P. (लयति) To melt,
dissolve. {vII.v} {c9c} P. (लिनाति)
1 To
adhere.
--2 To melt, usually with वि.
{vIII.v} {c4c} A. (लीयते, लीन)
1 To stick
or adhere firmly to, cling to;

.
--2 To clasp, embrace.
--3 To lie
or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in,
lurk, hide, cower; (भृगांगनाः) लीयंते
मुकुलांतरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव

.
--4
To be dissolved, melt away.
--5 To
be sticky or viscous.
--6 To
be absorbed in, be devoted or
attached to; माधव
मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भावनया त्वयि लीना

.
--7 To
vanish, disappear. --Caus. (
लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते, लालयति-ते) To
melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form
लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to
honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’;
जटाभिर्लापयते = पूजामधिगच्छति; cf.
